name: DroidLink
author: pym
description: Discover ADB devices and launch scrcpy from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Discover Android devices over USB and wireless ADB, then mirror them with scrcpy.

schema.label: Wake on mirror launch
schema.description: Turn the device screen on before scrcpy starts.

schema.label: Unlock on mirror launch
schema.description: Enter the device's saved unlock PIN once before scrcpy starts. Save the PIN from the device card first.

schema.label: Wake on connect
schema.description: Turn the screen on when a device connects (not when the shell starts).

schema.label: Unlock on connect
schema.description: Enter the saved unlock PIN once when a device connects (not when the shell starts).
